text: すてられたり　かえなくなった　ポケモンを　あずかって　せわ　してるの

structure.jp: すてられたり　かえなくなった　ポケモンを
structure.en: Pokémon that were abandoned or could no longer be kept

patterns.name: 〜たり
patterns.explanation: たり after a verb gives it as one example among others, 'things like'. すてられたり = 'were abandoned, or the like'.

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.explanation: なくなる after a verb means 'come to no longer' do it. かえる here is 'can keep', so かえなくなった = 'could no longer be kept'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The られる ending turns 'throw away' around so it happens to the Pokémon. すてられ = 'be abandoned'.
